_comment: SENSE board template. One entry per sensor driver the board can carry;
the wizard offers this list, asks only for the fields under 'params', and
infers everything else (MQTT host and port, topic, client id, unit, zone,
hostname) from the slot the operator picked and from config.env.
params[].kind   pin | int | float | bool | choice
params[].infer  present = not asked; the wizard fills it in
tags[]          what the driver publishes: one MQTT sub-topic each
Adding a sensor the fleet already supports is adding an entry here plus a
read_<id> function in edge/src/app/cea_sensors.py. Nothing else changes.
Defaults are the wiring of the reference build, not arbitrary values.
WIRING (the on-screen wiring screen, edge/src/host/wiring.py): a driver with
a `bus` block can be placed on a shared bus, behind a hub, more than once.
part            the picture in edge/templates/parts/<part>.json
bus             kind, the addresses it answers (addrs, default_addr), the
fastest clock it takes (max_freq), clock_stretch (informative:
the firmware's 250 ms bus timeout covers it on soft and hw)
power.rails     what it may be powered from; no 3V3 = a warning
quantities[]    what it measures: q, the default published tag, uom
default_off     quantities a newly placed instance starts with switched
off (optional; none ships: the SCD30's T/RH are on, Q13)
each reading is published on <base>/sense/<tag>/<sensor id>, so two
sensors may publish one tag; one sensor may not use a tag twice
wiring_only     no legacy pin params: not offered by the question loop
params[].legacy_bus  asked only by the question loop (its own bus pins)
Drivers without a `bus` block are the question loop's only.
hubs[], boards[] and gpio_reference describe the rest of the picture.

drivers.name: Sensirion SCD40 / SCD41
drivers.subtitle: CO2, air temperature, air humidity over I2C

params.name: scl_pin
params.label: SCL pin (I2C clock)
params.hint: GPIO the sensor's SCL line is on. YELLOW on the reference build.

params.name: sda_pin
params.label: SDA pin (I2C data)
params.hint: GPIO the sensor's SDA line is on. GREEN on the reference build.

params.name: i2c_id
params.label: I2C bus
params.hint: Hardware I2C peripheral. Either works with any GPIO on an S3.

params.name: i2c_freq
params.label: I2C frequency (Hz)
params.hint: 400 kHz is the SCD4x maximum. Drop to 50000 on long wiring.

params.name: altitude_masl
params.label: Altitude (m above sea level)
params.hint: The SCD4x corrects CO2 for air pressure. A wrong value biases every reading.

params.name: disable_auto_cal
params.label: Disable automatic self-calibration
params.hint: ASC assumes the sensor sees fresh air weekly. In a sealed chamber it does not, so leave this on.

drivers.name: Sensirion SCD30
drivers.subtitle: CO2, air temperature, air humidity over I2C

params.name: scl_pin
params.label: SCL pin (I2C clock)
params.hint: GPIO the sensor's SCL line is on.

params.name: sda_pin
params.label: SDA pin (I2C data)
params.hint: GPIO the sensor's SDA line is on.

drivers.name: Sensirion SHT45
drivers.subtitle: Air temperature and humidity over I2C

params.name: data_pin
params.label: 1-Wire data pin
params.hint: The probe's yellow/white line. Needs a 4.7k pull-up to 3V3.

drivers.name: Analogue water level probe
drivers.subtitle: Reservoir level on an ADC pin, powered only while reading

params.name: signal_pin
params.label: Signal pin (ADC)
params.hint: Must be an ADC-capable GPIO. On a classic ESP32 use ADC1: GPIO32-39.

params.name: power_pin
params.label: Power pin
params.hint: Drives the probe. Held low between readings — a continuously powered probe corrodes.

params.name: max_water_level
params.label: ADC reading at 100%
params.hint: Raw ADC count with the reservoir full. Calibrate once per install.

params.name: uart_id
params.label: UART id
params.hint: Only used by probe variants that also report over serial.

device_params.name: message_interval
device_params.label: Publish interval (seconds)
device_params.hint: How often the board reads its sensors and publishes. 30s matches the existing fleet.

inferred.name: mqtt_server
inferred.note: LAN address of the Mosquitto NodePort

inferred.name: client_id
inferred.note: unique per board, so two boards cannot evict each other

inferred.name: hostname
inferred.note: lower(unit)-s|c-lower(zone): DHCP name, dns_name and payload device_dns
